description: Search the approved source material of the person with this handle (CV, LinkedIn export, GitHub, web pages, FAQ) for passages matching a question; semantic and keyword search combined. Use it for specific questions, such as whether they have run Kafka in production, where list_experience is too broad. Returns up to limit passages, each with source_url and as_of. An empty result means their material doesn't cover it: say so rather than guess.
